Elements.Script: local Players = game:GetService('Players'); local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'); local lp = Players.LocalPlayer; getgenv().SZA_AutoGunHit = false; local function buildGunNameSet() local guns = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('Guns'); local set = {}; if guns then for _, child in ipairs(guns:GetChildren()) do set[child.Name] = true end end; return set end; local function findEquippedGun(gunSet) local char = lp.Character; if not char then return nil end; for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA('Tool') and gunSet[child.Name] then return child end end; return nil end; local function findBackpackGun(gunSet) local bp = lp:FindFirstChild('Backpack'); if not bp then return nil end; for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA('Tool') and gunSet[child.Name] then return child end end; return nil end; local function ensureGunEquipped(gunSet) local char = lp.Character; if not char then return nil end; local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid'); if not humanoid then return nil end; local equipped = findEquippedGun(gunSet); if equipped then return equipped.Name end; local bpGun = findBackpackGun(gunSet); if bpGun then pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(bpGun) end); return bpGun.Name end; return nil end; local function getZombieNumber(name) if type(name) ~= 'string' then return nil end; local num = string.match(name, '(%d+)$'); if num then return tonumber(num) end; return nil end; local function getZombiePos(zombie) if not zombie then return nil end; local hrp = zombie:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart', true); if hrp and hrp:IsA('BasePart') then return hrp.Position end; return nil end; local function isZombieAlive(zombie) if not zombie then return false end; return zombie:FindFirstChild('AnimationController', true) ~= nil end; Value:AddToggle('SZA_AutoGunHit', {Title = 'Auto Gun Hit', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SZA_AutoGunHit = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local gunHit = nil; local gunSet = {}; while getgenv().SZA_AutoGunHit do local ok = pcall(function() if not gunHit then local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('GunRemotes'); gunHit = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('GunHit') end; if not gunHit then task.wait(0.2); return end; gunSet = buildGunNameSet(); local gunName = ensureGunEquipped(gunSet); if not gunName then task.wait(0.2); return end; local zombies = workspace:FindFirstChild('Zombies_Local'); if not zombies then task.wait(0.2); return end; for _, z in ipairs(zombies:GetChildren()) do if isZombieAlive(z) then local num = getZombieNumber(z.Name); if num then local pos = getZombiePos(z); if pos then gunHit:FireServer(gunName, num, pos) end end end end end); if not ok then task.wait(0.25) end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'); getgenv().SZA_AutoWeaponUpgrade = false; Value:AddToggle('SZA_AutoWeaponUpgrade', {Title = 'Auto Weapon Upgrade', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SZA_AutoWeaponUpgrade = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local upgradeRemote = nil; while getgenv().SZA_AutoWeaponUpgrade do local ok = pcall(function() if not upgradeRemote then local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('UpgradeRemotes'); upgradeRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('PurchaseWeaponUpgrade') end; if upgradeRemote then upgradeRemote:FireServer() end end); if not ok then task.wait(0.25) end; task.wait(0.5) end end) end end})

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'); getgenv().SZA_AutoSkipVote = false; Value:AddToggle('SZA_AutoSkipVote', {Title = 'Auto Skip Vote', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SZA_AutoSkipVote = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local skipRemote = nil; while getgenv().SZA_AutoSkipVote do local ok = pcall(function() if not skipRemote then local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('WaveRemotes'); skipRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('SkipVote') end; if skipRemote then skipRemote:FireServer(true) end end); if not ok then task.wait(0.25) end; task.wait(0.3) end end) end end})

local Players = game:GetService('Players'); local lp = Players.LocalPlayer; local TARGET_POS = Vector3.new(27, -24, -261); getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyEnabled = false; getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyClone = nil; getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyOldCFrame = nil; local function stripScripts(model) for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('Script') or d:IsA('LocalScript') or d:IsA('ModuleScript') then d:Destroy() end end end; local function anchorParts(model, anchored) for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then d.Anchored = anchored; d.CanCollide = false; d.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0); d.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0) end end end; Value:AddToggle('SZA_FakeBody', {Title = 'Fake Body Teleport', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyEnabled = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local ok = pcall(function() local char = lp.Character; if not char then return end; local hrp = char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid'); if not hrp or not humanoid then return end; getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyOldCFrame = hrp.CFrame; hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(TARGET_POS); task.wait(0.3); humanoid.PlatformStand = true; hrp.Anchored = true; if getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyClone then pcall(function() getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyClone:Destroy() end); getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyClone = nil end; local clone = char:Clone(); stripScripts(clone); clone.Name = 'FakeBody'; clone.Parent = workspace; anchorParts(clone, true); local cloneHrp = clone:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if cloneHrp and getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyOldCFrame then cloneHrp.CFrame = getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyOldCFrame end; getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyClone = clone end); if not ok then task.wait(0.25) end end) else local ok = pcall(function() if getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyClone then getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyClone:Destroy(); getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyClone = nil end; local char = lp.Character; if not char then return end; local hrp = char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid'); if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false; if getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyOldCFrame then hrp.CFrame = getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyOldCFrame end end; if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = false end; getgenv().SZA_FakeBodyOldCFrame = nil end); if not ok then task.wait(0.25) end end end})
